notes: The app has its own icon now: the CUFMAI C with a loafer inside it
Fixed: in dark mode the seller's app bars, the POS screens and the notification swipe actions came out near-white, with white text on them
Fixed: sellers couldn't reach the appearance switch to choose a theme
Fixed: the Bulk Reservations queue opened onto "Something went wrong" instead of the list
The Bulk Reservations queue now speaks the Orders tab's language — the same tab bar, the same count badges, the same cards
The weekly and monthly revenue cards stack one column per channel, so a period's total is a height to read instead of two bands to compare by eye
The revenue ring is a solid object: hold it to pick it up, slide a finger to turn it, tap to send it round
The seller's bottom bar now steps aside while you scroll down a page, and is back the moment you scroll up
The dashboard's snapshot cards drop their captions — the numbers were already coloured to say what the words repeated
Fixed: a profile screen carried two Log Out buttons; the one in Settings is the one that stays
